Hi Vivek / Monica,

This is impacting latency-sensitive features for Archai's knowledge search (approx 18% of calls). Can Redwood step traffic back to the pinned stable variant (model-13c-stable) and open a temporary SLA carveout while we investigate? We're tracking this under our internal incident SUP-5678.

Attached is a short CSV extract of SLO samples (archai-slo-extract-20280705.csv) and a link to our incident notes.

We need:
- Immediate move of 100% traffic to model-13c-stable or a safe fallback within the hour,
- A note on expected user-visible impact,
- Confirmation of any credits or SLA exceptions per our agreement (section 4.2).

Thanks,
